BBQ Chicken

Allergen Call Out: Wheat, Milk

Pre-bake ingredients, bottom to top

  1. 1 ea. Pizza Dough Ball [BOOM 0101]
  2. 100 g Sweet Baby Ray’s BBQ Sauce
  3. 170 g Grande Cheese Shredded Mozzarella
  4. 200 g TILL Chicken [TILL010]
  5. 35 g Julienned Red Onion
  6. 20 g Shaved Garlic
  7. 15 g Calabrian Chiles
  8. 25 g Garlic Oil [BOOM 0107]
  9. 4 g BBQ Spice

Post bake, in order

  1. 12 g Scallions, 45° Bias
  2. 2 g Grated Romano Cheese
